question: As of November 2022, who among the following is the Governor of Uttar Pradesh, India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Anandiben Patel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Anandiben Patel has been serving as the Governor of Uttar Pradesh since July 2019.
 
• She has had a significant political career and is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Arif Mohammad Khan is not the current Governor of Uttar Pradesh. He has been serving as the Governor of Kerala since September 2019.
 
• Ram Naik, a prominent figure in the Bharatiya Janata Party, has also served as the Governor of Uttar Pradesh. However, his term was from 2014 to 2019, making him a predecessor to Anandiben Patel in this role.
 
• Sudarshan Agrawal is noted for his tenure as the Secretary-General of the Rajya Sabha from 2002 to 2007.
